title: Current Kitab Ghar React Home Page
purpose: Initial capture of the actual current main React application.
what_it_demonstrates: The current Layout, HomePage, Hero and GenieHero functional components compose the official main UI through JSX.

title: Current Home Component Output
purpose: Capture the next section of the actual main home page.
what_it_demonstrates: The running main UI shows composed React home-section components, including the Badlapur service content.

title: Book Genie Conditional Popup
purpose: Open Book Genie from the actual main home page.
what_it_demonstrates: The GenieHero open state conditionally renders BookGenieWizard JSX rather than a separate legacy interface.

title: Book Genie Interactive Child Components
purpose: Start the live Book Genie session.
what_it_demonstrates: The current wizard receives live book data and maps question options into visible child components using props and JSX.

title: Live BookCard Component List
purpose: Open the current API-backed Books page.
what_it_demonstrates: The actual BooksPage maps the live catalogue into 77 reusable BookCard components with book props.

title: Controlled React Search State
purpose: Search for Murakami in the live Books page.
what_it_demonstrates: The controlled input updates query state and changes the rendered BookCard output to the matching Norwegian Wood result.

title: Conditional Empty-State JSX
purpose: Search a title absent from the live catalogue.
what_it_demonstrates: Current component state makes the no-books-found JSX branch visible when no BookCard props remain to render.

title: Current React Mobile Layout
purpose: Capture the actual current home page at a 320 px viewport.
what_it_demonstrates: The current React component composition remains visible and within the narrow mobile viewport.
